name: print-advisor-mcp
description: Calculates 3D printing cost, time, material weight and build-plate fit from plain dimensions given in the conversation, with no STL upload and no API key. Covers PLA, PETG, ABS, ASA, TPU, Nylon, PC and PLA-CF, plus build volumes for Bambu Lab, Prusa, Creality, Voron and Elegoo printers.
